//@version=5
indicator("Liquidity + FVG + Structure Signal (Any TF)", overlay=true, max_lines_count=200, max_boxes_count=200, max_labels_count=200)

// ============================= INPUTS =============================
// Runs entirely off the chart's own timeframe — no weekly/HTF data pull needed.
// Works on any TF you load it on (1m, 5m, 15m, 1H, 1D, 1W, whatever's on the chart).

grpSR = "Support / Resistance"
pivotLen    = input.int(10, "Pivot Length (S/R + Liquidity swings)", minval=2, group=grpSR)
srTolPct    = input.float(0.25, "Zone Tolerance % (price counts as 'at zone')", minval=0.01, step=0.05, group=grpSR)
maxZones    = input.int(6, "Max S/R Zones Kept", minval=2, maxval=20, group=grpSR)

grpLiq = "Liquidity Setup"
liqTolPct   = input.float(0.15, "Equal High/Low Tolerance %", minval=0.01, step=0.05, group=grpLiq)
liqLookback = input.int(50, "Liquidity Pool Lookback (bars)", minval=10, group=grpLiq)
liqAvgLen   = input.int(20, "Liquidity Avg Length", minval=5, group=grpLiq)

grpFVG = "Fair Value Gap"
fvgMinAtr   = input.float(0.15, "Min FVG size (x ATR)", minval=0.01, step=0.05, group=grpFVG)
fvgAtrLen   = input.int(14, "ATR Length", minval=5, group=grpFVG)
showFVGBox  = input.bool(true, "Draw FVG Boxes", group=grpFVG)

grpSig = "Signal"
grpStruct = "Market Structure (HH/HL/LH/LL)"
showStructure = input.bool(true, "Show HH / HL / LH / LL Labels", group=grpStruct)

// ============================= MAJOR SUPPORT / RESISTANCE =============================
ph = ta.pivothigh(high, pivotLen, pivotLen)
pl = ta.pivotlow(low, pivotLen, pivotLen)

var float[] resLevels = array.new_float(0)
var float[] supLevels = array.new_float(0)

if not na(ph)
    array.unshift(resLevels, ph)
    if array.size(resLevels) > maxZones
        array.pop(resLevels)

if not na(pl)
    array.unshift(supLevels, pl)
    if array.size(supLevels) > maxZones
        array.pop(supLevels)

// draw current zone lines (remove old, redraw last known set)
var line[] resLines = array.new_line(0)
var line[] supLines = array.new_line(0)

if barstate.islast
    for l in resLines
        line.delete(l)
    array.clear(resLines)
    for l in supLines
        line.delete(l)
    array.clear(supLines)
    if array.size(resLevels) > 0
        for i = 0 to array.size(resLevels) - 1
            lvl = array.get(resLevels, i)
            ln = line.new(bar_index - 200, lvl, bar_index + 20, lvl, color=color.new(color.red, 40), width=1, style=line.style_dashed)
            array.push(resLines, ln)
    if array.size(supLevels) > 0
        for i = 0 to array.size(supLevels) - 1
            lvl = array.get(supLevels, i)
            ln = line.new(bar_index - 200, lvl, bar_index + 20, lvl, color=color.new(color.green, 40), width=1, style=line.style_dashed)
            array.push(supLines, ln)

f_nearestDist(arr, ref) =>
    float best = na
    if array.size(arr) > 0
        for i = 0 to array.size(arr) - 1
            v = array.get(arr, i)
            d = math.abs(ref - v) / ref * 100
            if na(best) or d < best
                best := d
    best

// ============================= MARKET STRUCTURE: HH / HL / LH / LL =============================
var float prevPH = na
var float prevPL = na
var string lastStruct = ""   // most recent structure break: "HH","LH","HL","LL"

if not na(ph)
    txt = na(prevPH) ? "H" : ph > prevPH ? "HH" : "LH"
    if not na(prevPH)
        lastStruct := txt
        if showStructure
            label.new(bar_index[pivotLen], ph, txt, style=label.style_label_down, color=color.new(color.silver, 0), textcolor=color.black, size=size.tiny)
    prevPH := ph

if not na(pl)
    txt = na(prevPL) ? "L" : pl > prevPL ? "HL" : "LL"
    if not na(prevPL)
        lastStruct := txt
        if showStructure
            label.new(bar_index[pivotLen], pl, txt, style=label.style_label_up, color=color.new(color.silver, 0), textcolor=color.black, size=size.tiny)
    prevPL := pl

bullStructure = lastStruct == "HH" or lastStruct == "HL"
bearStructure = lastStruct == "LL" or lastStruct == "LH"

resDist = f_nearestDist(resLevels, close)
supDist = f_nearestDist(supLevels, close)

atResistance = not na(resDist) and resDist <= srTolPct
atSupport    = not na(supDist) and supDist <= srTolPct

zoneText = atResistance ? "At Resistance" : atSupport ? "At Support" : "Neutral"

// ============================= LIQUIDITY SETUP (replaces Volume) =============================
// Pools = clusters of equal highs / equal lows within tolerance -> proxy for resting liquidity
f_poolCount(isHigh) =>
    int cnt = 0
    ref = isHigh ? high[pivotLen] : low[pivotLen]
    if not na(ref)
        for i = 1 to liqLookback
            v = isHigh ? high[i] : low[i]
            if not na(v) and math.abs(v - ref) / ref * 100 <= liqTolPct
                cnt += 1
    cnt

liqHighCount = f_poolCount(true)
liqLowCount  = f_poolCount(false)
liquidityScore = liqHighCount + liqLowCount
liquidityAvg   = ta.sma(liquidityScore, liqAvgLen)
liquidityRatio = liquidityAvg > 0 ? liquidityScore / liquidityAvg : 1.0

// Buyside liquidity = cluster of equal highs just above price (stops above)
// Sellside liquidity = cluster of equal lows just below price (stops below)
buysideLiquidity = liqHighCount >= 2
sellsideLiquidity = liqLowCount >= 2

// Liquidity sweep: wick pierces the pool level then candle closes back on the other side
sweptSellside = sellsideLiquidity and low < low[pivotLen] and close > low[pivotLen]
sweptBuyside  = buysideLiquidity and high > high[pivotLen] and close < high[pivotLen]

// --- visual liquidity sweep markers (fire on every sweep, not just full 3/3 signal) ---
grpSwp = "Liquidity Sweep Markers"
showSweeps = input.bool(true, "Show Liquidity Sweep Markers", group=grpSwp)

if showSweeps and sweptSellside
    label.new(bar_index, low, "SSL Swept", style=label.style_label_up, color=color.new(color.lime, 20), textcolor=color.black, size=size.tiny, yloc=yloc.belowbar)

if showSweeps and sweptBuyside
    label.new(bar_index, high, "BSL Swept", style=label.style_label_down, color=color.new(color.red, 20), textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny, yloc=yloc.abovebar)

plotshape(showSweeps and sweptSellside, title="Sellside Liquidity Swept", style=shape.circle, location=location.belowbar, color=color.lime, size=size.tiny)
plotshape(showSweeps and sweptBuyside, title="Buyside Liquidity Swept", style=shape.circle, location=location.abovebar, color=color.red, size=size.tiny)

alertcondition(sweptSellside, title="Sellside Liquidity Swept", message="Sellside liquidity (equal lows) swept — watch for bullish reversal")
alertcondition(sweptBuyside, title="Buyside Liquidity Swept", message="Buyside liquidity (equal highs) swept — watch for bearish reversal")

// ============================= FAIR VALUE GAP (FVG) =============================
atrVal = ta.atr(fvgAtrLen)

bullFVG = low[0] > high[2] and (low[0] - high[2]) >= fvgMinAtr * atrVal
bearFVG = high[0] < low[2] and (low[2] - high[0]) >= fvgMinAtr * atrVal

if showFVGBox and bullFVG
    box.new(bar_index[2], high[2], bar_index, low[0], border_color=color.new(color.lime, 60), bgcolor=color.new(color.lime, 85))

if showFVGBox and bearFVG
    box.new(bar_index[2], low[2], bar_index, high[0], border_color=color.new(color.red, 60), bgcolor=color.new(color.red, 85))

// "recent unmitigated FVG" flags (within last 15 bars, price hasn't fully closed through it)
var float lastBullFVGTop = na
var float lastBullFVGBot = na
var int   lastBullFVGBar = na
if bullFVG
    lastBullFVGTop := low[0]
    lastBullFVGBot := high[2]
    lastBullFVGBar := bar_index

var float lastBearFVGTop = na
var float lastBearFVGBot = na
var int   lastBearFVGBar = na
if bearFVG
    lastBearFVGTop := low[2]
    lastBearFVGBot := high[0]
    lastBearFVGBar := bar_index

recentBullFVG = not na(lastBullFVGBar) and (bar_index - lastBullFVGBar) <= 15 and close > lastBullFVGBot
recentBearFVG = not na(lastBearFVGBar) and (bar_index - lastBearFVGBar) <= 15 and close < lastBearFVGTop

// ============================= CONFIRM COUNTERS (out of 3) =============================
bullCond1 = atSupport
bullCond2 = sweptSellside
bullCond3 = recentBullFVG
bullConfirm = (bullCond1 ? 1 : 0) + (bullCond2 ? 1 : 0) + (bullCond3 ? 1 : 0)

bearCond1 = atResistance
bearCond2 = sweptBuyside
bearCond3 = recentBearFVG
bearConfirm = (bearCond1 ? 1 : 0) + (bearCond2 ? 1 : 0) + (bearCond3 ? 1 : 0)

buySignal  = bullConfirm == 3
sellSignal = bearConfirm == 3

plotshape(buySignal, title="BUY", style=shape.triangleup, location=location.belowbar, color=color.green, size=size.small, text="BUY")
plotshape(sellSignal, title="SELL", style=shape.triangledown, location=location.abovebar, color=color.red, size=size.small, text="SELL")

alertcondition(buySignal, title="Liquidity+FVG BUY", message="BUY: support zone + sellside liquidity swept + bullish FVG")
alertcondition(sellSignal, title="Liquidity+FVG SELL", message="SELL: resistance zone + buyside liquidity swept + bearish FVG")

// ============================= INFO TABLE =============================
var table t = table.new(position.top_right, 2, 5, border_width=1)

if barstate.islast
    table.cell(t, 0, 0, "Liquidity / Avg", bgcolor=color.gray, text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 1, 0, str.tostring(liquidityRatio, "#.##") + "x", bgcolor=color.gray, text_color=color.white)

    table.cell(t, 0, 1, "Zone", bgcolor=color.gray, text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 1, 1, zoneText, bgcolor=atResistance ? color.red : atSupport ? color.green : color.new(color.gray, 30), text_color=color.white)

    table.cell(t, 0, 2, "Bull confirm", bgcolor=color.gray, text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 1, 2, str.tostring(bullConfirm) + "/3", bgcolor=bullConfirm == 3 ? color.green : color.new(color.green, 70), text_color=color.white)

    table.cell(t, 0, 3, "Bear confirm", bgcolor=color.gray, text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 1, 3, str.tostring(bearConfirm) + "/3", bgcolor=bearConfirm == 3 ? color.red : color.new(color.red, 70), text_color=color.white)

    table.cell(t, 0, 4, "Structure", bgcolor=color.gray, text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 1, 4, (lastStruct == "" ? "—" : lastStruct) + "  (" + timeframe.period + ")", bgcolor=bullStructure ? color.new(color.green, 20) : bearStructure ? color.new(color.red, 20) : color.new(color.gray, 30), text_color=color.white
